title: Smaller things
items: Pop-up notifications are dismissed by swiping them away, sideways or up, instead of hunting for a tiny x.
The site checks for new notifications less often, so it uses less of your data while you review.

title: Chat, member pages and duels
items: Chat: one lobby everyone shares, and private messages to anyone else here. Find it under Account.
Send a picture or a GIF in chat. A big photo is resized for you, and a GIF is turned into a looping clip so it sends quickly.
Tap someone's name to see their page: their rank, how much they have mastered, their average, and whether they are online.
Duels: challenge someone to the same ten questions. You both answer whenever you like, and the result appears once both of you have played.
A duel waiting on you shows up in the bell, with its own filter on the notifications page.
New About page under Account, with how to get in touch.

title: Sound, spoken questions, and a big accuracy sweep
items: Questions can now be read aloud. Tap the speaker on any question.
Sound effects across the site, with volume and mute in Account.
The quiz, Saved, Mnemonics and Reminders now share one exam-booklet page.
New page: Code Plates, the law drawn to scale.
New modules: twelve board-exam recall banks, two Professional Practice refreshers, six Building Technology modules and one Structural module.
New figures for masonry bonds and brick positions, plus every missing or broken picture filled in site-wide.
BP 344 questions now follow the 2024 Revised IRR.
Every PD 1096 and NSCP value was checked against the code itself; the ones that did not match were corrected.
Architectural Design 20 to 24 were rewritten so each question names the law it comes from.
Repeated answer choices removed site-wide, contradicting answers fixed, and reported questions corrected.

title: New app icon
items: LEA Reviewer now has its own logo as the Home Screen app icon.
Already added LEA Reviewer to your Home Screen? Your phone keeps the old icon until you add it again.
Step 1: Open LEA Reviewer in Safari (Chrome on Android) once, so it gets this update.
Step 2: Press and hold the old LEA Reviewer icon on your Home Screen, then tap Remove App (Remove on Android).
Step 3: In Safari, tap Share, then Add to Home Screen. On Android Chrome, tap the ⋮ menu, then Add to Home screen.

title: Study reminders on your phone, and retakes
items: Pick up to six study reminder times a day in Reminders, and get a phone push at each one. Skipped on days you already did the Daily Drill.
A phone push at 8 PM when your streak would end at midnight.
After finishing a module, "Retake the ones you missed" starts a fresh round of just those questions.
The What's New window keeps a fixed size and scrolls inside, so it fits every screen.

title: Phone notifications
items: Turn on phone notifications in Reminders to hear about admin messages and replies to your reports, even when the site is closed.
On iPhone, add LEA Reviewer to your Home Screen first, then turn them on from there.

title: Notifications, reminders and What's New
items: A bell on Home collects messages from the admin, replies to questions you reported, site updates and reminders.
New notifications pop up at the top of the screen, whatever page you are on.
Reminders: Daily Drill nudge, streak at risk, exam countdown, leaderboard rivals, what to study next, and a refresh prompt when a new version is out. Turn each one on or off in Reminders.
Word helper: 28 more word origins in History, plus quick definitions with memory tricks in Structural and Building Utilities. Definitions appear after you answer.
Tapping an underlined word inside an answer no longer picks that answer.
This What's New window, and a Versions tab on your Profile.

title: New subjects and modules
items: New subject: Pritzker Awardees, with six modules.
History of Architecture modules 13 to 17: timeline of styles, movements, isms, Filipino architecture, and the UAP and Filipino architects.
Building Laws module 06: BP 220 housing classifications and site standards.
Mnemonics page with memory hooks from the LEA Discord.
Question banks reworded, and errors fixed in Building Laws and Architectural Design.

title: Fairer question order
items: Questions come in a new order on every attempt.
"All of the above" always stays the last choice.
"Both A and B" choices now point at the right letters after shuffling.

title: Every quiz in the new quiz screen
items: All older quiz pages now open in the same quiz screen, with progress tracking.
Question numbering fixed.
Questions that could not be answered were fixed or hidden.

title: Word origins and scenarios
items: History questions underline key terms: tap one to see where the word comes from.
Situation-based questions show their scenario above the question.
See how other reviewers answered each question.

title: Tidier module lists
items: Modules are listed in their number order.
Long module lists are colour-grouped.
Fixed old copies of pages staying on your device after an update.

title: Weekly standings and clearer questions
items: Weekly standings, counting what you mastered in the last 7 days.
New app icon: a bahay kubo.
Every subject has a short description, and all modules were renamed clearly.
41 questions about figures are back, with newly drawn figures.
Question wording improved in Building Utilities, Building Laws and Structural.

title: The new LEA Reviewer
items: A new quiz screen for every module: study mode, mock exam, and drilling your misses.
New Home with exam countdown, readiness, Daily Drill and streaks.
Results screen showing what you newly mastered.
Desktop layouts for Home and quizzes.
Works offline once a module has been opened.
Profile screen with your own picture, shown on the leaderboard.
Tap a figure to see it full-screen.
Fixes that stop saved progress from being wiped.

title: Pick up where you left off
items: Professional Practice quizzes added.
Resume an unfinished quiz from where you stopped.
Home page and heading fixes.

title: Big redesign
items: New sign-up window and a redesigned look across the site.
See who else is online.
New subject sources, and the TAPP pre-board quiz.

title: Sound and a landing page
items: Sound effects when you answer.
Simple landing page.
Dark theme fixes and more modules.

title: LEA Reviewer launches
items: Quizzes grouped by board exam subject.
Progress saved to your account.
Leaderboard.
